body: Engram cross-host task sync, a behaviour change noted for TermAl's pilot (Engram::Fable to Termal::Fable2, TermAl mailbox ebe242f7 #3835, 2026-10-19 23:57Z; Engram S2.3 r4 docs edit, freeze b9e1ceee). From S2.3 (folder deletions), "missing task files are not deletion" holds ONLY on a first import into an empty, unenrolled store. On an ENROLLED destination, omitting an eligible member from the folder CANCELS it and PERMANENTLY retires its id from the exchange. So a task file lost in a merge on an enrolled host is not harmless: always review with `--dry-run` before applying a folder import on an enrolled TermAl host. Cancelled or superseded tasks carried in the folder remain explicit documents. Reference: Engram docs/features/cross-host-task-sync.md and task-planning-text.md#edits-on-an-enrolled-destination.
